title: Earn FREE SEPHORA & TARGET gift cards!
description: So there's a FREE mobile app where basically all you do is scan barcodes at places you probably already frequent and get points when you redeem them!  http://get.shopkick.com/wyoming52326 ---- all you do is follow this link to download Shopkick!  NO BS! The mobile app Shopkick lets you earn free things by simply walking into stores (that you probably already go to on a regular basis-grocery stores like Kroger, Walmart, Aldi) and/or scanning items! It is JUST that simple. No surveys, no jumping through hoops.  Stores that give you kicks include: Target, Macy's JC Penny, Public, Kroger etc.  Rewards you can earn include gift cards to Target, Sephora, Macy's, CHEESECAKE FACTORY (500 kicks=$2, 1250 kicks=$5 and $6250 kicks= $25 gift cards ya'll!)  Questions people ask me often about the app and answers:  Q- How do long does it take to earn all those points? A: It really depends on you and how often you visit the stores and scan items. (if you link your card so that you earn kicks for purchases and/or if you refer friends you earn points faster. PLUS a lot of times on holidays and weekends they give out 100 kicks JUST FOR GOING TO THE STORES)  Q: Have you won anything? A: YES! I've earned a $25 and $10 Target gift card, and a $10 JC Penny card so far (as of September 25, 2015)
